text: {"lessons":["My account has risen overall despite several declines, reminding me that short-term moves are noisy and do not reliably predict what comes next.","My buys and sells changed my holdings, but I should judge trades by their fit with my diversification and risk plan—not by whether a position is above or below its average cost.","Since losses affect me strongly and I cannot borrow, I will make deliberate decisions, preserve sufficient cash, and avoid reacting to daily price swings."]}
